summary: Business development director with over two decades of B2B sales leadership, selling performance improvement products and largely intangible services to Fortune 500 and enterprise clients. Designs custom engagement initiatives for employees, channel partners and consumer groups, and sells to C-suite and executive stakeholders on multi-million-dollar projects. Experienced in national and district sales management, account territory growth, staff leadership, budgeting and forecasting, and training program design, with a track record of exceeding sales targets and winning new accounts in long sales cycles.
